learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic principles of the different subjects that make up this applied and professional module.
Propose and solve questions raised in the different subjects.
Conduct market prospecting on products related to the different subjects presented, detect the advantages and disadvantages of products, considering their economic and environmental cost.
Propose systems and perform simulations and real projects related to the different subjects.

syllabus_topics: Finite element simulation of deformation processes (with MSC Marc and MSC Superform): Introduction to FEM
Mesh generation methods (for deformation processes)
Introduction and determination of material behavior (for deformation processes)
Friction and contacts (for deformation processes)
Contact conditions (for deformation processes)
Load cases (for deformation processes)
Calculation (for deformation processes)
Post-processing and results analysis (for deformation processes)
Simulation of material removal processes (with Surfcam): Introduction to CAM systems
Generation of part geometry (for material removal)
Design of machining operations
Selection of process conditions (for material removal)
Calculation (for material removal processes)
Verification and post-processing (for material removal processes)
Resolution of exercises (for material removal processes)
Finite element simulation of plastic injection processes (with Moldex 3D): Introduction to plastic injection molding
Generation of part and mold geometries (for plastic injection)
Meshing of geometries (for plastic injection)
Design of gate points (for plastic injection)
Calculation (for plastic injection processes)
Post-processing and results analysis (for plastic injection processes)
Introduction to FEM, FVM and CAD-CAM-CAE systems
Methods of geometry and mesh generation in CAD-CAM-CAE systems
Introduction and determination of material behavior in CAE systems
Contact conditions, friction and contacts in CAE systems
Load Cases and Selection of process conditions in CAM-CAE systems
Calculation in CAM-CAE systems
Post-processing, verification and results analysis in CAM-CAE systems
CAE-CAD-CAM software
Practical cases of process and component design in Manufacturing Processes Engineering using CAM-CAE systems
Calculation of components in manufacturing equipment (brakes, clamps, fixtures, dies, punches, etc.)
Calculation of manufacturing processes
assessment_rules: Oral presentations (ME1) are recoverable by performing the presentation. Works and reports (ME2) are recoverable by performing the final course work. No minimum grade is required for individual activities.
